faq.a: Some packs are free and others are paid. Each pack page shows the price before you decide, and free packs can be opened straight away.

faq.q: What format are the notes and e-books in?
faq.a: PDF. They open on any phone, tablet or computer without a special app.

faq.q: Which exams and careers do you cover?
faq.a: Government exams such as SSC, Banking, Railway and UPSC, plus career tracks like Data Analyst. Tracks that are not ready yet are marked Coming soon.

faq.q: Will you add more than government exams?
faq.a: Yes. Career tracks such as software, marketing and finance are next, followed by mock tests and learner accounts.
